limits.en: Unlimited electronic invoicing (DGFiP-approved platform), unlimited quotes and invoices, automated bookkeeping; excludes mandatory tax declarations

keyLimits.en: Unlimited invoicing and quotes, automated bookkeeping; no mandatory tax declarations included
Adds e-signature of quotes, automated late-payment reminders, pro account with 3 sub-accounts; no mandatory tax declarations
Adds automated mandatory tax declarations, one-click government filings, priority support; price varies by legal structure (auto-entrepreneur shown, other structures range 22-49 EUR/month HT)

cautions.en: Premium plan pricing varies significantly by legal structure: 15-19 EUR/month for auto-entrepreneurs, 22-49 EUR/month for individual enterprises, 24 EUR/month for SCI/LMNP, 49 EUR/month for companies (SAS/SASU/SARL/EURL).
Neither the free Essentiel nor the Plus plan includes mandatory tax declarations; that requires Premium.

capabilities.en: Automated invoicing and quoting via a DGFiP-approved electronic invoicing platform, built for French freelancers.
Automated bookkeeping and, on Premium, automated mandatory tax declarations with one-click government filings.

limitations.en: Mandatory tax declarations are gated behind the Premium plan; not available on the free or Plus tiers.
Premium plan cost depends on legal structure, complicating direct price comparison across business types.

reason.en: Direct competitor for French freelancer banking, invoicing and tax management, already flagged as a current alternative.
Overlaps on business banking and invoicing for French independents and small teams.
Competes on automated invoicing and bookkeeping for freelancers, though not France-specific.

unknowns: Exact price for the Premium plan across all legal structures (SCI/LMNP annual figure vs monthly not fully reconciled) was only partially detailed on the page.
